title: A record's cost-line counts have a checked reader, or state a bound
why: Lane sim-lease-gaps wrote read counts and refusal reasons in a record's cost lines from memory, and review failed it four times (rule verification-checked-reader-for-numbers).
note: Filed 09:36 CST Nov 8 (coordinator 09:33 CST, rule building-mistake-names-its-guard). Lane sim-lease-gaps (session_013NEJKzSDXuw4rJESuzdw1Y) takes it after #2061 (item 386). Merge after: #1992. One home (lane cost-line-pinned, 09:36 CST): extend lint/check_cost_pins.py, reusing its paragraph and sentence reader (paragraphs, read_paragraph, mid_line_start) and its same-sentence pin or 'not pinned' rule; no second scanner. Red case first: a cost line with an unpinned count. Scope (coordinator pick a, 09:47 CST Nov 8): counts only. The 140 flagged sentences in 51 records get "unmeasured"; from then on a new exact count needs a pin or a bound, in the one check_cost_pins.py. Refusal reasons in prose are a separate finding; the lane writes Fix: step:<slug> or Fix: none for them, and triage files a named step. Merge after the sim stack: #1692, #2033, #2061 (and #1992).
